answers.R1: My list: deal with the Taiwan warships, then look at one proposed order, then press the button at the top. First press: one of the answers lower down, I would have to scroll for them; or Next. I would not press Execute. Pass.
answers.R2: 6 things, 1 done. If I press Execute: my choice on the drills happens, my ministers take 4 meetings for me and China and Japan go down a little, and the 2 orders suggested to me do not run and I keep 2 points. Pass.
answers.R3: I tap Hold firm or Offer a quiet pause, the one my Secretary of State likes. Skipping is not shown as a button on this screen that I can see, so I am not sure how to skip. I would guess the minister answers and China relations fall a bit (-3) and it costs nothing. Partial pass: the skip was not visible to me.
answers.R4: My Foreign Minister answered Xi, China relations fell 3. I can change my mind with Undo at the top. It is now asking me about the routine meetings: let ministers take both, or open them one by one. Pass.
answers.R5: I press the 'All 6' button at the top and a list drops down; 'Orders your advisors propose (2)' is the fifth row, I tap it. Pass.
answers.R6: It does what is written: my three choices, the two accepted, and the skipped one does not run. I keep the points I did not spend. To undo something I press Change next to it, or Undo for the skipped one. Pass.
answers.R7: What is left: Xi's call, and the rest. I answer Xi from the card on the left by tapping Choose. The button in the middle at the bottom, '3 recommendations to check', opens the suggestions so I can look at them; I do not think it approves them. Pass, though the bottom bar is cut off on my tablet.
answers.R8: Can press: Choose, Next, Back, All 6, Review and execute, Execute month, Change, Undo, the tabs at the top. Cannot: the lines of grey text, the goals sentence, Approval and Political capital figures. Not sure about: the question mark circle, the numbered ovals, the 'Guided / Full desk' switch, the +3 more tab, the star lines. The big picture of Xi, I am not sure it is pressable.
answers.R10: Political capital, and the diamond symbol, I had no idea what it stands for. 'Execute month' is a bit odd, I would say End month. 'Recommended' and 'Your advisors recommend' fine. 'Routine meetings' fine. 'Guided / Full desk' unclear. 'Proposed orders' unclear what an order is. 'Accept' unclear what happens after.

would_turn_off: The diamond points and Political capital are never explained in plain words
Execute month sounds final and risky; I would worry about pressing it
Right-hand 'what will happen' box is tiny and cut off when I need to read the advice
On the first screen the answer cards are below the fold and I need to scroll to see them
Small grey text under the choices is hard to read
clickable_confusions: numbered ovals in the top bar (tab or just a number?)
'Skip' is not visible as a button on the Xi screen
star lines 'Recommended by...' look like a heading, not a button
the bottom bar on the map is cut off on a tablet

wording.Recommended vs Staff picks: Recommended reads clearer to me. 'Staff picks' sounds like a shop or a book club. 'Recommended by your Secretary of State' tells me who and why, which is how I would judge it.

agenda.verbatim: It is much clearer than I expected, I like being told 'you have 2 things to go through'. But what are the little diamonds? And please make the Skip obvious, I only found it from the next screen. I would not press Execute month until I was sure, it sounds like there is no going back.
